sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed side-on orthographic camera with a 3D cutaway arena (2.5D)
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPURenderer with WebGPU and WebGL 2 fallback; Rapier 2D 0.19.3; Gamepad API; Web Audio API; PeerJS 1.5.5; AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0; HTML/CSS/JavaScript
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural cel-shaded characters and a hand-inked waterworks diorama; copper, sea-green tile, cream paper, thick outlines, comic impact lettering
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer, AnimationClip and NumberKeyframeTrack for breathing, scuttling, jumping and kicking; procedural particles, flips, and platform recoil
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-composed swing chiptune, oscillator sound effects, and formant-filtered Animalese-style gibberish voices. No audio files. Music defaults to 10%.
sourceInformation.online: 1–4 player host-authoritative shared-world co-op via AI Hub; standalone six-digit WebRTC rooms using PeerJS signaling and BroadcastChannel for same-browser tabs; 1–4 couch co-op
sourceInformation.testing: 46/46 automated checks passed. Headless scripted state checks and a full eight-shift campaign; Chromium software WebGPU and WebGL 2; WebKit; virtual standard controllers and touch profiles; OfflineAudioContext music measurements; two isolated browser contexts using real WebRTC; AI Hub harness with 2 and 4 players, 150 ms latency, 50 ms jitter, 5% loss, host departure and a dedicated host. Physical controllers, real touch hardware and external NAT traversal: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Nintendo Arcade Archives Mario Bros. description and screenshots; 1983 Atari instruction manual; Mario Wiki and Wikipedia mechanics and soundtrack notes; Three.js r180 source and animation documentation; Rapier, PeerJS and AI Hub protocol documentation

aiHub.name: Drainio Bros.
aiHub.description: Clock in with Pip and the night crew for an ink-and-copper arcade caper. Bump pests from below, chase down a boot chain, race for loose change, and clear the Big Clog across eight waterworks shifts.
aiHub.controls: Stick/D-pad or A-D: move; Cross/Space: jump; Square/E: boot or BOP nearby; Down+Jump: drop; Options/Esc: pause. Pop: arrows, Up/Right Shift, Right Ctrl. Touch: drag left, tap right, contextual action.
